name: dateadd_keeps_time
sql: SELECT id, DATEADD(day, 7, ts) AS d7 FROM orders

orders.schema: id int, ts timestamp, amt double

_note: Expected values follow Snowflake's documented behavior (DATEADD keeps the timestamp); confirm on your own account. This case is meant to FAIL on Spark 3.5 because DATE_ADD returns a DATE.
